display.about: Settings → Display (T42, A576): sidebar shortcuts the user hides. Sent in /sync/tree and taken by PUT /api/settings; the Android app reads this block for Settings → Display (T40 matrix ST12, A650), kept apart from `keys` for its own rule and `refused` list. Only false hides one: the web stores true when it is shown again, and a PUT with null removes the key; both show it. Agents cannot write these keys (A564).
